lessons.title: Boss: The Library Window
lessons.goal: 整合行程表、任務長度、截止時間與緩衝。
lessons.story:
[Saturday plan]
Noah wants to finish a history poster and return library books. The library closes at 4:30 p.m. He needs ten minutes to walk there, five minutes to return the books, and ten minutes to walk home.

[At 3:00 p.m.]
His poster still needs forty minutes of work. His friend suggests doing it first and then watching a twenty-minute video together. Noah also wants ten spare minutes before the library closes in case the return desk is busy.

[Two choices]
Plan A: Poster, video, then library.
Plan B: Poster, library, then video.

Noah draws a timeline. Under Plan A, he would reach the library at 4:10 and finish at 4:15 if nothing goes wrong. Under Plan B, he would finish returning books at 3:55. Both plans fit the closing time, but only one gives him more than half an hour after the planned return to handle trouble.

words.example: Keep ten spare minutes in your plan.
His friend suggests watching a video.
Leave enough time to handle trouble.
The extra time helps if there is trouble.

questions.prompt: How much work does the poster still need?
questions.evidence: His poster still needs forty minutes of work.
reasons: 這是單程步行或最低預備時間。

questions.prompt: When does the poster finish if Noah starts at 3:00?
questions.evidence: His poster still needs forty minutes of work.

questions.prompt: What comes immediately after the poster in Plan B?
options: Another forty minutes of poster work.
questions.explanation: B順序是海報、圖書館、影片。
questions.evidence: Plan B: Poster, library, then video.

questions.prompt: How many minutes remain between the planned return completion and closing in Plan A?
questions.evidence: Under Plan A, he would reach the library at 4:10 and finish at 4:15 if nothing goes wrong.
reasons: 十是最低希望預備，不是實際剩餘。

questions.prompt: Why does Noah keep spare time?
options: The walk home always takes an hour.
The return desk may take longer than expected.
He expects the library to close at 3:00.
He needs to watch the video at the return desk.
questions.explanation: 備用時間是因應還書櫃台忙碌。
questions.evidence: in case the return desk is busy.
reasons: 支持等待可能增加的推論。

questions.prompt: What does “handle” mean in the last sentence?
questions.explanation: handle trouble 是處理突發狀況，不是握把的字面意思。

questions.prompt: Which plan provides more than thirty minutes after the planned book return and before closing?
questions.evidence: Under Plan B, he would finish returning books at 3:55.

questions.prompt: What is the best reason to prefer Plan B?
options: It guarantees that no unexpected event can happen.
It removes the need to walk home.
It does the deadline-bound errand before an activity that can wait.
questions.explanation: 順序調整讓有關門限制的還書先完成，影片可後做；不是保證零風險。
questions.evidence: Plan B: Poster, library, then video.
reasons: 增加緩衝不能保證絕無意外。
把有期限事項排在較彈性的活動之前。
